verdict.rationale: Forter documents a maintained Shopify integration where you supply an Admin API token and "Forter handles everything". Its extensions docs describe configuration under "Merchant Tools > Site Preferences", which implies a Salesforce Commerce Cloud extension, though the docs never name the platform. PSP coverage is shown only for Stripe dispute webhooks, which feed chargeback ingestion. Missing for 10: any BigCommerce integration, explicit naming and documentation of the Salesforce Commerce extension, PSP integrations beyond Stripe and beyond disputes (e.g. Adyen, Braintree, Checkout.com), and independent corroboration that these integrations are maintained.
